WITH overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(imgcount) AS overall_avg_imgcount
  FROM scanenvironment
  WHERE imgcount IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT s.entrystat,
       AVG(e.ambictemp) AS avg_ambictemp,
       AVG(e.imgcount) AS avg_imgcount,
       AVG(e.imgcount) - overall.overall_avg_imgcount AS imgcount_avg_difference
FROM scanenvironment AS e
JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = e.zoneref
CROSS JOIN overall
GROUP BY s.entrystat;
